name: Kettleman Station
summary: Kettleman Station is a community-oriented shopping center in Lodi, California, focused on serving family lifestyle needs through locally-owned businesses centered around home, health, and family services. The plaza offers dining, medical offices, fitness facilities, personal care services, and flexible commercial space options.
demographics: Kettleman Station serves San Joaquin County families in Lodi, California, a mid-sized city with a diverse, family-oriented population. The trade area attracts middle-income households seeking convenient access to health services, dining, and personal care amenities. Primary visitors include working families, health-conscious residents utilizing the medical offices and fitness facilities, and local community members supporting small, locally-owned businesses. The center's focus on home, health, and family services indicates a customer base that values practical, everyday shopping needs over luxury retail experiences.
description: Kettleman Station is a community-focused commercial center located at 400 East Kettleman Lane in Lodi, California, designed to serve the lifestyle needs of San Joaquin County families. Unlike traditional shopping centers, Kettleman Station distinguishes itself by centering its tenant mix around three core pillars: home, health, and family. The plaza features a carefully curated selection of locally-owned restaurants where families can dine together, comprehensive medical offices for healthcare needs, and wellness-focused amenities including a gym and dance center. Visitors can also enjoy personal services at the on-site spa and salons, making it a one-stop destination for daily living needs. The center's commitment to supporting small, locally-owned businesses creates a unique community atmosphere that sets it apart from corporate chain-dominated shopping destinations. With flexible space options including storefront retail, conference room rentals, and Clearsuites office space, Kettleman Station serves both consumers and entrepreneurs in the Lodi area.
